in_sanskrit.name: Bikrom
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Strong, Powerful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bikrom एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bikrom is derived from the Sanskrit words 'bhi' meaning fear or strength and 'krom' meaning doer or maker. This name represents a powerful and fearless individual who is a doer and maker in life.
